headline: What are these developers up to? Kraków is more expensive than Warsaw!
summary: In the third quarter, developers in Kraków began adding cheaper apartments to their offers after months of pricier launches, according to an Otodom report. Kraków is now pricier than Warsaw in some segments.
why: Otodom is a major Polish property portal, and developer pricing trends indicate the direction of the residential property market.
